intended_use: preclinical computational research only; not diagnostic or treatment guidance
dataset_selection_policy: Prefer public human PDAC organoid or cell-model data with explicit treatment labels, stable accession identifiers, and downloadable processed data. Do not infer treatment outcomes from expression data alone.

datasets.title: Uncovering the hidden threat: single-organoid analysis reveals clinically relevant treatment-resistant and invasive subclones in pancreatic cancer
datasets.role: primary organoid response and heterogeneity dataset
datasets.design: PDAC patient-derived organoid panel (8 organoid lines); baseline samples and a subset exposed to gemcitabine plus paclitaxel; study includes single-organoid response and invasive/resistant subclone analysis.
datasets.available_data: GEO supplementary processed files and SRA raw sequencing data; inspect sample-level metadata before assigning groups.
limitations: Small number of patient-derived organoid lines
Treated samples are a subset of the panel
Expression data alone do not encode a calibrated dose-response curve
Do not treat organoid response as patient treatment advice
datasets.geo_sample_composition: 23 baseline organoid RNA-seq samples and 7 Gemcitabine+Paclitaxel-treated samples; 8 patient-derived organoid lines overall. Verify all GSM-to-line and replicate mappings from SOFT/MINiML before analysis.
datasets.geo_response_endpoint: No complete longitudinal growth/dose-response matrix is established by the GEO series record. GEO provides processed RNA-seq count files; the study reports live-cell image-derived response metrics and retrospective clinical comparison that must be extracted from the publication supplements with sample linkage.
datasets.sample_metadata_audit: series-level search result and representative GSM metadata checked; full 30-sample mapping pending
datasets.model_eligibility: candidate for response-heterogeneity analysis only after publication response tables and GSM mappings are extracted; do not train a transcriptome predictor on 8 lines

datasets.title: Patient-derived organoids after neoadjuvant FOLFIRINOX predict therapy resistance in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma
datasets.design: Ten PDAC organoid lines from treatment-naive and neoadjuvant-FOLFIRINOX-treated patients, with matched primary tissue/organoid transcriptomic samples; drug-sensitivity assays include 5-FU, irinotecan, and oxaliplatin.
data_types: organoid drug-sensitivity assay results described by the study
datasets.available_data: GEO supplementary CSV files; phenotype tables and sample mappings must be independently checked against the publication supplements.
limitations: Neoadjuvant exposure is not equivalent to prospective response prediction
Drug-sensitivity phenotype tables must be acquired and linked by verified sample identifiers
Avoid leakage between matched tissue/organoid samples
datasets.geo_sample_composition: 10 matched primary-tissue/organoid pairs: 5 treatment-naive and 5 after eight cycles of neoadjuvant FOLFIRINOX; 20 transcriptomic samples.
datasets.geo_response_endpoint: GEO provides TPM and raw-count matrices, not the drug-sensitivity assay table. The paper describes organoid sensitivity assays to 5-FU, irinotecan and oxaliplatin; retrieve exact phenotype values and sample mapping from paper supplements before modeling.
datasets.sample_metadata_audit: series-level GEO record and linked publication checked; sample-level pairing and assay table linkage pending
datasets.model_eligibility: independent treatment-context transcriptome cohort; not a standalone supervised drug-response dataset until phenotype table is recovered

datasets.title: Profiling the Panc1 pancreatic cancer cell line following Gemcitabine treatment using single cell RNA sequencing
datasets.design: PANC-1 in-vitro gemcitabine exposure and acquired-resistance model, including single-cell RNA-seq comparisons.
limitations: Single cell line; not a patient cohort
Use for resistance-mechanism stress testing only, not population-level calibration
datasets.geo_sample_composition: 6 samples: PANC-1 control, 24-hour gemcitabine exposure, and PANC-1 gemcitabine-resistant derivative with three perturbation conditions (amlodipine, BAPTA-AM, W-7).
datasets.geo_response_endpoint: single-cell transcriptomic profiles; not a patient-derived organoid drug-response cohort
datasets.model_eligibility: mechanistic resistance stress-test only; exclude from patient-derived organoid calibration

datasets.title: Establishing 3D Organoid Models from Patient-Derived Conditionally Reprogrammed Cells to Bridge Preclinical and Clinical Insights in Pancreatic Cancer
datasets.role: candidate independent organoid transcriptome context; not currently a response-labeled GEO cohort
datasets.design: GEO series contains five control RNA-seq samples from patient-derived 3D organoids (YCLO-1, YCLO-2, YCLO-4, YCLO-6, YCLO-7). The associated publication reports drug-sensitivity experiments, but the GEO series record lists only control RNA-seq samples.
limitations: Only five control RNA-seq samples in GEO
No treatment-arm RNA-seq samples are listed in the GEO series record
Do not treat GEO as containing drug-response labels
Drug-response claims belong to the publication and need separately sourced data
datasets.available_data: GEO raw count files and SRA raw data; study drug-sensitivity/clinical comparison tables require retrieval from publication supplements or authors and verified linkage.
datasets.geo_response_endpoint: not present in the GEO series sample design
datasets.sample_metadata_audit: series-level GEO metadata and associated publication data-availability statement checked
datasets.model_eligibility: transcriptomic context only until supplementary phenotype data and linkage are obtained

datasets.title: Organoid Profiling Identifies Common Responders to Chemotherapy in Pancreatic Cancer
datasets.public_status: dbGaP study; access requirements vary by data type
datasets.design: Published study profiled 66 PDAC-confirmed patient-derived organoids against gemcitabine, paclitaxel, SN-38, 5-FU, and oxaliplatin, with retrospective patient follow-up for a small matched subset.
limitations: Only a small matched patient subset
Retrospective association is not proof of treatment benefit
Use only under applicable data-access approvals
datasets.model_eligibility: not eligible for calibration until sample metadata and response endpoint are verified

reproducibility_requirements: Record accession, sample accession, file name, retrieval date, source URL, byte size, and SHA-256 for every downloaded file.
Preserve raw source files; perform preprocessing into versioned derived files.
Build an explicit sample-to-organoid-to-treatment mapping and reject ambiguous mappings.
Keep patient-level grouping intact during train/validation splits.
Never mix cell-line, organoid, and patient-cohort observations without explicit domain labels.
